title: FLA import: shapeEase never set from binary — shape tweens always import as linear
description: flash8-import.ts ~line 967 only maps f.motionEase as motionEase but never sets shapeEase for shape-tween keyframes. The binary stores one ease value for all tween types (motionEase in the Fla8Frame struct). For tweenType=shape, the ease value should be forwarded as shapeEase. Fix: when tweenType === 'shape', set shapeEase: f.motionEase (the ease value in the binary is the same field regardless of tween type). Also check if shapeBlend (distributive/angular) is decodable from the binary — if so, decode and forward it too.
